description_full: Datatec Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides information and communication technology (ICT) solutions and services in North America, Europe, the Asia-Pacific, Africa, and the Middle East. It operates through Westcon International, Logicalis International, and Logicalis Latin America segments. The company cyber security, network infrastructure, unified collaboration products, data centre solutions, and channel services, and financing/leasing solutions for ICT customers, as well as digital services. It also distributes security and networking products. Datatec Limited was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Sandown, South Africa.

financial_summary: DATATEC is a small-cap technology business with a $1.9B market cap on $3.7B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at -11% over the past three years, and a shrinking top line is the hardest headwind any business can overcome.

Returns on capital run at 18% against a 9% cost of capital — a 10-point spread that is the clearest signature of an economic moat, and 24% gross margins are typical of commodity economics where competitors can replicate the product cheaply.

The business throws off $90M in free cash flow — roughly 2 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.27× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage runs at 4.0×.

Shareholder yield of 2.1% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insiders hold 13% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and profit capture is only 0.3× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
